title: Poster at EGU General Assembly 2026
title_zh: 在 EGU General Assembly 2026 作墙报报告
content: Presented the poster *Emergence of Robust Zonal Jets in a Differentially Heated Rotating Annulus* (S. Ding and P. Read, [EGU26-19406](https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-egu26-19406)) at the EGU General Assembly 2026, held in Vienna, 3–8 May 2026. A video of the presentation, *Energetics of Zonal Jet Flows in a Thermally Driven Rotating Annulus*, is available on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n11SVAL64v8).
content_zh: 在 EGU General Assembly 2026（维也纳，2026 年 5 月 3–8 日）报告墙报 *Emergence of Robust Zonal Jets in a Differentially Heated Rotating Annulus*（S. Ding and P. Read，[EGU26-19406](https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-egu26-19406)）。报告视频 *Energetics of Zonal Jet Flows in a Thermally Driven Rotating Annulus* 见 [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n11SVAL64v8)。

title: PRL paper selected as Editor's Suggestion and Featured in Physics
title_zh: PRL 论文入选 Editor's Suggestion，并 Featured in Physics
content: Our paper *Stratification-dependent enstrophy-controlled regime in geostrophic turbulence* (S.-S. Ding et al., *Phys. Rev. Lett.* **136**, 114101, 2026) has been selected as an **Editor's Suggestion** and **Featured in Physics**. The work experimentally reveals how baroclinic instability shapes the k⁻³ energy spectrum in geostrophic turbulence.
content_zh: 我们的论文 *Stratification-dependent enstrophy-controlled regime in geostrophic turbulence*（S.-S. Ding et al.，*Phys. Rev. Lett.* **136**, 114101, 2026）入选 **Editor's Suggestion**，并 **Featured in Physics**。该工作通过实验揭示了斜压不稳定性如何塑造地转湍流中的 k⁻³ 能量谱。

title: Oral presentation at the Geophysical and Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics Conference
title_zh: 在 Geophysical and Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics Conference 作口头报告
content: Presented our latest results on zonal jet flows and geostrophic turbulence in the rotating annulus experiment at the Geophysical and Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics Conference.
content_zh: 在 Geophysical and Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics Conference 报告旋转环槽实验中纬向急流与地转湍流的最新结果。

title: New paper published: Predicting IBL growth in stratified boundary layers
title_zh: 新论文发表：分层边界层中 IBL 增长的预测
content: Our paper *Predicting full growth of internal boundary layers induced by a roughness change in neutrally and stably stratified circumstances* is published in *Journal of Fluid Mechanics* (1016: R4, 2025).
content_zh: 我们的论文 *Predicting full growth of internal boundary layers induced by a roughness change in neutrally and stably stratified circumstances* 发表于 *Journal of Fluid Mechanics*（1016: R4, 2025）。

title: Paper published in Measurement Science and Technology
title_zh: 论文发表于 Measurement Science and Technology
content: *Turbulence statistics estimation across a step change in roughness via interpretable network-based modelling* published in *Meas. Sci. Technol.* 36(1): 016026 (2025), with collaborators at University of Surrey.
content_zh: *Turbulence statistics estimation across a step change in roughness via interpretable network-based modelling* 发表于 *Meas. Sci. Technol.* 36(1): 016026 (2025)，合作者来自 University of Surrey。

title: New JFM paper on stratified boundary layer statistics
title_zh: JFM 新论文：分层边界层统计性质
content: *Statistical properties of neutrally and stably stratified boundary layers in response to an abrupt change in surface roughness* published in *Journal of Fluid Mechanics* 986, A4 (2024).
content_zh: *Statistical properties of neutrally and stably stratified boundary layers in response to an abrupt change in surface roughness* 发表于 *Journal of Fluid Mechanics* 986, A4 (2024)。
